<?php

class TokenService {
    private string $secretKey;
    private string $algorithm = 'sha256';
    
    public function __construct(string $secretKey) {
        if (strlen($secretKey) < 32) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Key must be at least 32 bytes');
        }
        $this->secretKey = $secretKey;
    }
    
    /**
     * Compute a binding value for signature that includes structured claims
     * This ensures the signature covers the exact semantic meaning of each field
     * rather than just a string representation that could be ambiguous
     */
    private function computeClaimsBinding(array $claims): string {
        // Pack claims into a canonical binary format for signing
        // This prevents JSON serialization ambiguity attacks
        $binding = '';
        $binding .= pack('a32', str_pad($claims['sub'] ?? '', 32, "\0"));
        $binding .= pack('a16', str_pad($claims['role'] ?? '', 16, "\0"));
        $binding .= pack('l', (int)($claims['iat'] ?? 0));  // signed 32-bit timestamp
        $binding .= pack('l', (int)($claims['exp'] ?? 0));  // signed 32-bit timestamp
        $binding .= pack('a16', str_pad($claims['jti'] ?? '', 16, "\0"));
        return $binding;
    }
    
    /**
     * Generate HMAC signature over the canonical binary binding
     */
    private function computeSignature(array $claims): string {
        $binding = $this->computeClaimsBinding($claims);
        return hash_hmac($this->algorithm, $binding, $this->secretKey);
    }
    
    /**
     * Issue a new signed token
     */
    public function issueToken(string $subject, string $role, int $ttlSeconds = 3600): string {
        $now = time();
        $claims = [
            'sub' => $subject,
            'role' => $role,
            'iat' => $now,
            'exp' => $now + $ttlSeconds,
            'jti' => bin2hex(random_bytes(8))
        ];
        
        $signature = $this->computeSignature($claims);
        $payload = base64_encode(json_encode($claims, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES));
        
        return $payload . '.' . $signature;
    }
    
    /**
     * Verify and decode a token
     */
    public function verifyToken(string $token): ?array {
        $parts = explode('.', $token, 2);
        if (count($parts) !== 2) {
            return null;
        }
        
        [$encodedPayload, $providedSignature] = $parts;
        
        // Validate signature format
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/', $providedSignature)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Decode payload
        $json = base64_decode($encodedPayload, true);
        if ($json === false) {
            return null;
        }
        
        $claims = json_decode($json, true);
        if (!is_array($claims)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Verify required fields exist
        $required = ['sub', 'role', 'iat', 'exp', 'jti'];
        foreach ($required as $field) {
            if (!isset($claims[$field])) {
                return null;
            }
        }
        
        // Verify signature using timing-safe comparison
        $expectedSignature = $this->computeSignature($claims);
        if (!hash_equals($expectedSignature, $providedSignature)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Check expiration using the claim value directly
        if ((int)$claims['exp'] < time()) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Check not issued in the future (5 second leeway)
        if ((int)$claims['iat'] > time() + 5) {
            return null;
        }
        
        return $claims;
    }
    
    /**
     * Check if user has required role level
     */
    public function hasRole(array $claims, string $requiredRole): bool {
        $hierarchy = ['viewer' => 1, 'editor' => 2, 'admin' => 3, 'superadmin' => 4];
        $userLevel = $hierarchy[$claims['role']] ?? 0;
        $requiredLevel = $hierarchy[$requiredRole] ?? PHP_INT_MAX;
        return $userLevel >= $requiredLevel;
    }
}

class ApiGateway {
    private TokenService $tokenService;
    private array $auditLog = [];
    
    public function __construct(TokenService $tokenService) {
        $this->tokenService = $tokenService;
    }
    
    public function handleRequest(string $method, string $path, array $headers): array {
        $authHeader = $headers['Authorization'] ?? '';
        if (!preg_match('/^Bearer\s+(.+)$/', $authHeader, $matches)) {
            return ['status' => 401, 'body' => 'Missing authentication'];
        }
        
        $token = $matches[1];
        $claims = $this->tokenService->verifyToken($token);
        
        if ($claims === null) {
            $this->auditLog[] = ['event' => 'auth_failure', 'time' => time()];
            return ['status' => 401, 'body' => 'Invalid token'];
        }
        
        // Route-based authorization
        $requiredRole = $this->getRequiredRole($method, $path);
        if (!$this->tokenService->hasRole($claims, $requiredRole)) {
            $this->auditLog[] = [
                'event' => 'authz_failure',
                'sub' => $claims['sub'],
                'role' => $claims['role'],
                'required' => $requiredRole,
                'time' => time()
            ];
            return ['status' => 403, 'body' => 'Insufficient permissions'];
        }
        
        $this->auditLog[] = [
            'event' => 'access_granted',
            'sub' => $claims['sub'],
            'path' => $path,
            'time' => time()
        ];
        
        return ['status' => 200, 'body' => 'OK', 'user' => $claims];
    }
    
    private function getRequiredRole(string $method, string $path): string {
        if (str_starts_with($path, '/admin')) {
            return 'admin';
        }
        if ($method === 'DELETE' || $method === 'PUT') {
            return 'editor';
        }
        return 'viewer';
    }
}
